releases.notes:
BackBridge 0.1.21

Added
- Added the J hotkey to build upward by holding jump and placing blocks against the last confirmed support block.

Changed
- Build-up mode now honors inventory exhaustion mode from the existing H toggle.
- Retuned build-up placement to retry every tick during the jump placement window instead of using the slower horizontal placement cadence.
- Relaxed build-up placement previewing so the real placement call can handle tight player-collision timing while still validating target position, block state, and survival.
- Updated the README with the current release and controls.

Fixed
- Expanded whitelisted obstacle clearing to cover grass, ferns, and crops such as wheat in addition to flowers.

releases.notes:
BackBridge 0.1.19

Added
- Added a comprehensive in-repo changelog and linked it from the README.

Changed
- Locked active runs to the walk surface height captured at start.
- Tightened placement prediction to follow vanilla block placement before each block is placed.

Fixed
- Prevented full blocks in the lane from stepping the bridge upward.
- Preserved lower-slab behavior while rejecting placements that change the original path surface height.
- Restored whitelisted torch and flower clearing before bridge placement.

releases.notes:
BackBridge 0.1.9

- Builds a backward bridge from the selected hotbar slot with a single hotkey.
- Uses offhand torches only when the local block light above a confirmed bridge block is 1 or lower.
- The mouse still controls direction while the run is active.
- In survival mode, using the feature makes you an easy target while movement is constrained.
